about_the_game:
`What is - A PvP browser game set in a low-poly, outer-space, battle arena. Players compete with skill-shots, power-ups, and good old team work.

`What is a syncer?` - A `syncer` is a fictional AI that uses the universal ethereal energy `sync`, as fuel to power a players space-ship, as well as their abilities and techno-spells.

`Development` - Player feedback is integral to creating a fun gaming experience. Community voting will take place regarding development periodically. These votes will determine new features to be added, tweaked, or removed.

`Platforms` - Syncers is playable in browser. Development on Mobile (android), and PC (Steam), is underway. With release dates in late 2025.

`Who's the team?` - @krint.dev is developing syncers solo and spends most of his waking hours staring at the screen... Feel free to DM @krint.dev a #posturecheck anytime! But he gets IT support from @x_nck_x , dotNet/webDev help from @fondarella , and general coding/design help from @natty0.!

`How do I play!?` - Super easy, visit

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 2 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon HD 7850
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card.
